item.title: 2026 Thanksgiving
item.description: Thursday 26 November 2026, for 6 adults and a child. A Thanksgiving that keeps the familiar notes (turkey with sage gravy, a sharp cranberry relish, creamy potatoes, a glazed root vegetable, an apple dessert) and adds cider-glazed ribs, smoked outside or baked the day before. Two mains, three sides, soft rolls and two desserts. One oven, with the meatballs, the cake and every sauce made before Thursday.

item.title: Braised beef chuck with mushrooms and thyme
item.description: A boneless chuck roast cut into large pieces, dry-brined, seared hard, and braised low in porter and stock with onions, garlic, tomato paste and thyme until it yields to a spoon. Browned cremini go in at the end and a splash of vinegar sharpens the sauce. Built to be cooked a day ahead and reheated on the stovetop.

item.title: Cider-glazed baby back ribs
item.description: Two racks of baby back ribs, dry-brined overnight, rubbed with brown sugar, smoked paprika, mustard, fennel and sage, cooked low until a probe slides between the bones, then lacquered with a reduced apple cider and mustard glaze. Smoke them on any smoker, or slow-bake them the day before and glaze them in a hot oven, or do one rack each way.

item.title: Cranberry mostarda
item.description: Fresh cranberries cooked into a loose syrup with brown sugar, red wine vinegar, shallot, orange and whole mustard seeds, then finished off the heat with cold-bloomed mustard powder. Sweet, sharply sour and nose-clearing, it is a cranberry sauce built for rich meats.

item.title: Apple crumble with brown butter oat topping
item.description: A 9 x 13 inch crumble built on a two-apple blend: Granny Smith for acid and structure, Honeycrisp or Pink Lady for aromatic sweetness, set with a small dose of cornstarch so the juices bake into a glossy syrup instead of a puddle. The topping is brown butter worked into flour, oats, brown sugar, and toasted pecans, then chilled so it bakes into crisp clusters rather than a sandy sheet.

item.title: Arugula, pear, and pomegranate salad with goat cheese
item.description: Baby arugula, paper-thin pear, pomegranate arils, salted toasted almonds, and crumbled fresh goat cheese, dressed at the table with a shallot, cider, and dijon vinaigrette that carries a spoonful of white miso. Built as the sharp, raw, crisp counterweight to a rich holiday table: pepper from the arugula, acid from the cider and pomegranate, crunch from the almonds, and lactic tang from the cheese.

item.title: Beef Wellington with red wine jus
item.description: Center-cut beef tenderloin, dry-brined and seared, wrapped in prosciutto and a dry mushroom duxelles, then in all-butter puff pastry, and baked hot on a preheated sheet until the pastry is deep gold and the beef is medium-rare to the edge. Two days of short, separate steps make the hardest roast in the repertoire manageable, and a reduced red wine jus supplies the acid the pastry and beef need.

item.title: Crème fraîche
item.description: Heavy cream cultured at room temperature with a spoonful of live buttermilk until lactic acid bacteria sour and thicken it. Two ingredients and two days of waiting give a cream that is nutty, gently sour and thick enough to hold a spoon upright, and that does not curdle in a hot sauce.

item.title: Hasselback potato gratin
item.description: Unrinsed Yukon Gold slices tossed in garlic-and-thyme-infused cream with gruyère and parmigiano, then stood upright in tight rows so the exposed edges roast into a crisp, frilled top while the buried half braises creamy. The format splits the gratin into two textures in one dish: a crackling ridge of browned potato and cheese above a soft, starch-thickened base.

item.title: Herb-crusted rack of lamb with cranberry mostarda
item.description: Two frenched racks of lamb dry-brined overnight, seared fat-side down in cast iron, brushed with dijon, pressed into a crust of breadcrumbs, parsley, rosemary, thyme, garlic, lemon zest, and parmigiano, then roasted at 220 °C to a 52 °C pull and rested to medium-rare. A sharp cranberry mostarda (cranberries, vinegar, two mustard seeds, and cold-bloomed dry mustard) does the job that cranberry sauce does for turkey: it is the acid and the heat that cut the lamb fat.

item.title: Maple-cumin roasted carrots
item.description: Carrots hard-roasted at 220 °C until their edges caramelize, then lacquered in the last minutes with a glaze of maple syrup, white miso, freshly toasted cumin, and Aleppo pepper, and finished with lemon, toasted pistachios, dill, and mint. Sweet, savory, warm-spiced, and bright, and built to sit at room temperature so the oven is free for the mains.

item.title: Parker House rolls
item.description: Sixteen soft, buttery, fold-over dinner rolls from a honey-and-milk enriched dough with a tangzhong (cooked flour-milk paste), which keeps the crumb tender for a full day after baking. Each round of dough is rolled into an oval, brushed with butter, and folded so the roll bakes with a pull-apart seam, then finished with more butter and flaky salt.

item.title: Pumpkin Basque cheesecake
item.description: A crustless Basque-style cheesecake with pumpkin purée, brown sugar and warm spice, baked hot until the top scorches to near-black while the center stays soft. The bitter caramel top plays the role of a pie crust against a custard that tastes like pumpkin pie made richer.

item.title: Roasted delicata squash with hot honey and pepitas
item.description: Unpeeled delicata half-moons roasted cut-side down at 220 °C until the faces caramelize and the thin skin turns tender. A quick chili honey cut with cider vinegar, lime, salty cotija and toasted pepitas keep the sweet squash on the savory side of the table.

item.title: Sweet potato dinner rolls with honey butter
item.description: Soft, pull-apart milk-bread rolls with roasted sweet potato worked into the dough. The sweet potato adds moisture, color and a gentle sweetness, and its starch keeps the crumb soft for a day. Served with whipped honey butter and flaky salt.

item.title: Tres leches cake
item.description: A butterless, separated-egg sponge baked in a 9 x 13 pan, pierced all over and soaked overnight with evaporated milk, sweetened condensed milk and cinnamon-steeped whole milk. The open, dry crumb drinks more than its own weight in milk and stays cake rather than turning to pudding. A crème fraîche whipped cream on top cuts the sweetness.

item.title: Turkey and sage meatballs with brown butter gravy
item.description: Ground turkey bound with a sourdough-and-milk panade and a bloomed sheet of gelatin, so the lean meat stays juicy after roasting and a day in the fridge. The meatballs roast hard at 230 °C for browning, then sit overnight in a brown butter and sage pan gravy built on the sheet-pan drippings, soy and cider vinegar.

item.title: Whole roasted red snapper with sourdough fennel stuffing
item.description: Two whole red snappers, scored and dry-brined, packed with a sourdough stuffing built on brown butter, sweated fennel and celery, melted anchovy, lemon zest, and a fistful of parsley and dill, then roasted hot at 220 °C until the skin blisters and the flesh at the spine reads 57 °C. Finished at the table with a brown-butter lemon caper sauce. It is the stuffing note of a traditional Thanksgiving carried by fish instead of turkey: crisp-edged bread soaked in butter and fish juices, and a centerpiece that carves in minutes.

item.title: Thunder tea rice (lei cha)
item.description: The Hakka one-bowl meal: a dark green soup of green tea, Thai basil, mint, laksa leaf, cilantro, toasted sesame and peanuts, pounded to a paste and loosened with hot water, poured over jasmine rice crowned with separately stir-fried long beans, choy sum, golden tofu, sweet-salty preserved radish and roasted peanuts. Bitter, herbal and nutty in the soup; salty, sweet and crunchy on the rice.

item.title: Vanilla bean paste
item.description: Vanilla extract suspended in a syrup with the scraped seeds of the pod. Same flavor as a whole bean, a fraction of the price, and you get the visible black flecks.

item.title: Vanilla extract
item.description: Cured vanilla pods steeped in ethanol. Vanillin is the headline aromatic; the 250+ supporting compounds are what separates real extract from synthetic.

item.title: Chai pumpkin cupcakes
item.description: Pumpkin cupcakes with the spice infused into the milk like a real chai, then frosted with brown butter cream cheese.

item.title: Chocolate stout cake
item.description: A small two-layer 4-inch chocolate cake where dry Irish stout replaces the liquid, melted with butter and blooming the cocoa so its roasted-barley bitterness reads as deeper chocolate. Sour cream and dark brown sugar keep the crumb dense and damp, and a lightly sweetened whipped cream-cheese frosting sits on top like the head on a pint.

item.title: Chocolate Texas sheet cake
item.description: A thin, fudgy half-sheet chocolate cake built from a boiled butter-coffee-cocoa base and buttermilk, then flooded while still warm with a poured brown-butter cocoa icing and toasted pecans. The warm-on-warm pour is the defining move: the icing sinks a few millimeters into the crumb and sets into a soft fudge layer rather than sitting on top as frosting.

item.title: Individual decadent chocolate cakes
item.description: Two 4-inch chocolate cakes built on a chocolate-butter emulsion and bloomed Dutch cocoa, with brown sugar for moisture and a turbinado crackle top. No frosting: the cake itself is the payload.

item.title: Midnight velvet mini cake with strawberry and balsamic caviar
item.description: A two-layer 4-inch chocolate cake bloomed with hot coffee, filled with strawberry reduction, finished with strawberry meringue buttercream, balsamic pearls, and tempered chocolate shards.

item.title: Molten chocolate lava cakes
item.description: Two 4-inch molten chocolate cakes built on brown butter and 70% dark chocolate, lifted by a ribbon-stage egg foam with an extra yolk for a custard-thick core, and baked hot and fast so the rim sets while the center stays liquid. About 30 minutes start to finish, one saucepan and one bowl.

item.title: Sticky toffee pudding
item.description: A soft, dark sponge made with Medjool dates softened in boiling water and baking soda, sweetened with dark muscovado, then soaked while warm in a muscovado, butter and cream toffee sauce. The British pub classic: the sponge should be moist enough to drink up the sauce without turning to mush.

item.title: Thai iced tea (no dye)
item.description: Small-batch Thai iced tea built on whole spices and loose-leaf black tea — no orange food coloring, low astringency, evaporated milk float.

item.title: Thai iced tea with salted vanilla whip
item.description: Spiced black tea sweetened with brown sugar and condensed milk, finished with a soft-peak salted vanilla cream that floats and slowly cascades.
